name: SNS Network Technology Berhad
overview: SNS Network Technology Berhad 在2026年与 MIMOS Holdings 及 KKRM 的合资协议于7月3日无条件生效，合资公司 MIMOS Network Sdn. Bhd. 已成立，涉及 ICT Solutions 业务。此外，公司与 AGMO Studio 的谅解备忘录在3月4日公告中表示自上次公告以来无重大进展。
overview_en: SNS Network Technology Berhad's joint venture agreement with MIMOS Holdings and KKRM became unconditional on 3 July 2026, and the joint venture company MIMOS Network Sdn. Bhd. was incorporated, relating to the ICT Solutions business. Additionally, the company's memorandum of understanding with AGMO Studio was announced on 4 March 2026 with no material development since the last announcement.

segments.name: ICT 解决方案
segments.note: 今年与 MIMOS Holdings 及 KKRM 成立合资公司 MIMOS Network Sdn. Bhd.，合资协议于7月3日无条件生效。
segments.note_en: This year, a joint venture company MIMOS Network Sdn. Bhd. was incorporated with MIMOS Holdings and KKRM, and the joint venture agreement became unconditional on 3 July.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 与 MIMOS Holdings 及 KKRM 的合资协议所有先决条件已达成，于2026年7月3日无条件生效，合资公司 MIMOS Network Sdn. Bhd. 已于2025年10月21日成立。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent of the joint venture agreement with MIMOS Holdings and KKRM were fulfilled, and the agreement became unconditional on 3 July 2026; the joint venture company MIMOS Network Sdn. Bhd. was incorporated on 21 October 2025.

segments.name: 集团
segments.note: 与 AGMO Studio 的谅解备忘录自上次公告以来无重大进展。
segments.note_en: There has been no material development to the memorandum of understanding with AGMO Studio since the last announcement.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 AGMO Studio Sdn. Bhd. 的谅解备忘录自2025年12月4日公告以来无重大进展。
actions.text_en: There has been no material development to the memorandum of understanding with AGMO Studio Sdn. Bhd. since the announcement on 4 December 2025.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过合资公司 MIMOS Network Sdn. Bhd. 成立，进入与 MIMOS Holdings 及 KKRM 合作的业务领域。
model_changes.text_en: Through the incorporation of joint venture company MIMOS Network Sdn. Bhd., the company entered a business area in collaboration with MIMOS Holdings and KKRM.
